formal_statement.plain_language: For t=2 and N=b², the two-level superblock summation absolute error is at most γ_(2(b−1)) times the sum of absolute inputs.

informal_proof: The paper counts b−1 rounded additions in each block and b−1 in the outer accumulator; the two error factors combine within γ_(2(b−1)).
